summary.name: Translatium
summary.one_liner: Translatium (Lexibird) is an AI translation app that translates text, images, audio, and documents in 200+ languages, with Mac and Windows apps and a Chrome extension.
use_cases: translate text, images, audio, or documents
translate text on screen that cannot be copied
keep team terminology consistent with glossaries
look up word definitions and pronunciation
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI translation tool for text, images, audio, and documents across 200+ languages, aimed at preserving tone, meaning, and nuance. Lexibird, a companion feature, is available for Mac and Windows and can select any area of the screen and translate its text, even when it cannot be copied. It can be opened with a chosen keyboard shortcut and lives in the menu bar or system tray. A Chrome extension translates text while browsing. For teams, glossaries set how names and product terms are translated, and the page mentions choosing among advanced AI models and a shared workspace with plan management.
notable: Lexibird screen translation works even when text cannot be copied
Zero data retention claim: AI providers don't keep content
Listed in awesome-mac; open-source desktop repo referenced
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
The 200+ vs 100+ language count differs between the page and the awesome-mac listing
Team features require a workspace plan; plan details not given
